Step 1 Open the product and add water till 80% capacity. For better results, you can add rose petals or cucumber. Step 2 Freeze in a freezer for a minimum of 4 hours For best results, use it once a day for 3 months. Step 3 Once frozen, rinse under water and then open the cover Step 4 Apply ice to the face in 30-second intervals and in circular motions Important Information To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use this ice roller regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4.
